     9	def evaluate_filter(filter_str, user):

    11	        tree = ast.parse(filter_str, mode='eval')
    12	    except SyntaxError:
    13	        raise ValueError("invalid filter")

    15	    def eval_node(node):
    16	        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
    17	            return node.value

    19	            if node.id in ['id', 'name', 'email']:
    20	                return user.get(node.id)
    21	            else:
    22	                raise ValueError("invalid field")
    23	        elif isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
    24	            left = eval_node(node.left)
    25	            if len(node.ops) != 1:
    26	                raise ValueError("invalid operator")
    27	            op = node.ops[0]
    28	            right = eval_node(node.comparators[0])
    29	            
    30	            if isinstance(op, ast.Eq):
    31	                return left == right
    32	            elif isinstance(op, ast.NotEq):
    33	                return left != right
    34	            elif isinstance(op, ast.Lt):
    35	                return left < right
    36	            elif isinstance(op, ast.LtE):
    37	                return left <= right
